paragraphs.text: Graveborn is a seldom used creature type which only appears on tokens for a type of undead associated with both red and black mana.

A Graveborn is a type of undead that, unlike regular Zombies , has red in their color identity instead of only black . They appear as large, bulky, green-skinned creatures with sharp teeth and are composed of what appears to be rotting flesh. The type was introduced in Alliances and was not seen again until Coldsnap . Thus far, all Graveborn have been 3/1 red and black creatures with haste .
